content.title: Shriram Nene Discusses Importance of Youth Wellbeing and Preventive Healthcare
content.caption: Shriram Nene, a cardiothoracic surgeon and healthcare innovator, emphasizes the need for healthy habits and preventive healthcare from an early age.
